# Usr3 card-mount flag

u16 set to 1 only when Usr3 posted the card mount, on a power-switch boot; 0 on the other boots.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0x61843f64` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

On a battery-connect boot the flag is 0 and the application mounts the card instead, so its power-off sends no Usr3 unmount. The mount runs asynchronously; wait for the media status before opening files.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): fenykl's loader gates power-switch boots on this flag. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).
